version: JCP completion v1 fixed before new production
continuation: Continue last saved state with fixed original production step/turn, no readaptation or extra discarded equilibration. Distinct new RNG streams seed+200000+1000*segment, segment1..6, are not new physical seeds. Original and appended raw files retained separately. Smoke test is excluded.
endpoint: Fixed 80000 frames each regardless of interim sign, p value or interval. Monitor integrity and progress only. Do not stop when significant/nonsignificant or when equivalence first passes. Any later extension needs a new recorded protocol, not silent endpoint change.
primary: Original paired EFS-EDH P2(ui dot uj) shell moment, shell[0.9,1.5], original radial domain[0.55,6], width0.05, equal mean of three seed means. Preserve original 500-frame stratified bootstrap-t 20000 resamples RNG810134; 95% interval and two-sided p; absolute diagnostic margin +/-0.00075. No old N2048 included.
segments_reporting: Report original20k unchanged, new60k alone, combined80k, every10k segment, halves and quarters. New segment follows old state and is not an independent trajectory or fully blind test; no data deletion based on diagnostics.
robustness_rule: Do not declare robust precision merely because primary500 passes if1000/2000/4000 intervals materially broaden or leave margin. Report lack of plateau as unresolved; do not select the most favorable block size. Original primary result is always retained.
secondary: Five moments in four original radial shells for each seed, Holm60 family. Individual primary Holm3. Torque24 and angular1536 families separately exploratory. Energy,S2,Q,lowest-wavevector real/imaginary density AND density power: ACF, ESS, block errors, time segments, target correlation. Nominal correlation p values are exploratory and not causal evidence. Check continued-state continuity, coordinate/unit-axis integrity, physical core samples and code hashes.
step4_plan: Primary independent reference: physical seeds410131+410132 EDH, test410133 EFS/EDH; no reference/test frame overlap and no use of EFS as truth. Leave-one-seed-out rotations exploratory. Same d=3 measure and original 0.05 radial,4x4x8 angular resolution; r bins wholly within[0.9,5.5]. Relative RMS=sum(volume*angular measure*(estimate-reference)^2)/sum(volume*angular measure*reference^2), square root. No occupancy mask for primary. Thresholds radial0.5%,full angular2%, not the primary angular-moment absolute margin. M=50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000,10000,20000; contiguous and dispersed repeated sampling. Freeze exact randomization and uncertainty algorithm before computing efficiencies. Reference block500/1000/2000/4000 sensitivity; require reference uncertainty less than target/3 and reference-seed compatibility, otherwise report unresolved precision rather than sample savings. No new independent seed until this adequacy review.
